UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Represents the customized biographical details, mission parameters, and preferences of an authenticated Boss user.

uid.description: The unique Firebase authenticated user identifier.

name.description: Preferred voice alias, e.g., 'Boss' or a real name.

location.description: Primary base, control room, or operational lab.

mission.description: The primary core directive or overarching objective of their system.

interests.description: User specific scientific or analytical domains of interest.

preferences.description: Key-value mapping of interface parameters (e.g., color accents, audio, language code).

setupCompleted.description: Indicates if the interactive onboarding sequence has concluded.

UserMemory.title: User Memory
UserMemory.description: Wrapper block storing isolated cognitive contexts for the user.

EpisodicMemoryItem.title: Episodic Memory Item
EpisodicMemoryItem.description: Chronological chronicle of past sensory activities, actions, or diagnostic runs.

SemanticMemory.title: Semantic Graph Memory
SemanticMemory.description: Long-term knowledge relationships mapped into nodes and connecting edges.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message Log
ChatMessage.description: Chat log lines for full persistent conversational context replay.

KeepNote.title: Keep Note
KeepNote.description: Custom virtual-Keep note for logging persistent memos and lists.

/users/{userId}.description: Dynamic user core profile documentation and onboarding registry.

/users/{userId}/memory/core.description: Holds the dynamic session contexts and system focus fields for this user.

/users/{userId}/memory/episodic.description: Collection or doc containing a listing of episodic occurrences.

/users/{userId}/memory/semantic.description: The user's private semantic relationship graph schema representation.

/users/{userId}/memory/chat_history.description: Collection or doc container storing historical conversation turns.

/users/{userId}/keep_notes/{noteId}.description: User specific collection of Keep synchronized or locally serialized virtual notes.
